issue_context.title: Cloud paths with square brackets in paths are not treated as non-glob paths, even with `glob=False`
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
df = pl.read_parquet("gs://foo/[bar]/baz.parquet", glob=False)
```


### Log output

```
None
```
### Issue description

Although `glob=False` is provided, I believe that the path is interpreted as a wildcard path.

Although the file naming scheme is not even supported by the `gsutil` CLI, I am running into this issue when using `polars` with `dagster_polars`.

Dagster uses the convention of naming its "step keys" with square brackets, which is then used for filenames. I think you also saw this as being an issue in https://github.com/dagster-io/dagster/issues/21451

### Expected behavior

When `glob=False` is provided, square brackets should not be interpreted as wildcards.

### Installed versions

```

Platform:             macOS-14.5-arm64-arm-64bit
```
